sections.admission_summary: Chief complaint: Sudden severe headache, vomiting, altered consciousness. Admitted for inpatient care.
sections.discharge_instructions: Drink plenty of fluids. Get adequate rest and avoid overexertion. Neurology/neurosurgery follow-up within 2-4 weeks. Repeat imaging per plan. Strict blood pressure control is essential. Do NOT restart anticoagulants without specialist approval. Return to ER immediately for: sudden severe headache, new or worsening weakness/speech difficulty, altered consciousness. Resume a normal diet gradually as tolerated. Strict blood pressure control (BP <140/90 target). Continue rehabilitation. Call ambulance immediately for severe headache, vomiting, weakness recurrence, or consciousness change. Activity restrictions per neurologist. Early rehabilitation as tolerated. Low-sodium diet. Blood pressure home monitoring twice daily.
sections.discharge_medications: Amlodipine 5-10mg PO daily; Levetiracetam 500mg PO BID
sections.follow_up: Neurology/neurosurgery follow-up within 2-4 weeks. Repeat imaging per plan.
